name: Hulen Mall
summary: Hulen Mall is Fort Worth's relaxed regional shopping destination featuring department stores, fashion chains, and a food court, plus distinctive open-air dining options. Located in southwest Fort Worth, the mall offers unique-to-market shops with the latest in apparel and housewares, making it a comprehensive retail hub for the community.
demographics: Hulen Mall attracts a diverse middle to upper-middle class demographic in the Fort Worth area, with a strong presence of families and young professionals aged 25-54. The trade area serves affluent neighborhoods in southwest Fort Worth and surrounding suburbs, with household incomes typically ranging from $60,000 to $100,000+. Shoppers are drawn to the mall's mix of department stores and fashion retailers, with typical visitors seeking both everyday shopping needs and special occasion purchases. The center benefits from its location near residential communities and serves as a primary retail destination for the southwest Fort Worth market.
description: Hulen Mall stands as Fort Worth's premier enclosed shopping destination, offering a comprehensive retail experience at 4800 South Hulen Street in the heart of southwest Fort Worth. This relaxed yet vibrant regional mall features an impressive collection of department stores and fashion chains, complemented by a full-service food court and distinctive open-air restaurants that provide shoppers with diverse dining options. The mall has established itself as a community gathering place, attracting visitors with its unique-to-market shops that showcase the latest trends in apparel, housewares, and lifestyle products. With convenient hours throughout the week and extended shopping times on Fridays and Saturdays, Hulen Mall accommodates busy schedules while maintaining its reputation as a go-to destination for both everyday needs and special shopping excursions. The center's prime location and diverse tenant mix have made it a cornerstone of Fort Worth retail, serving generations of shoppers who appreciate its blend of national retailers, comfortable atmosphere, and commitment to providing a complete shopping experience.
